itineraries.title: Thursday Night Departure from Pune to Mysore
itineraries.description: Depart comfortably on Thursday night (01 October 2026) from Pune in New AC Urbania with Pushback seats. Overnight journey to Karnataka.

itineraries.title: Arrival in Royal Mysore – Palace, Chamundeshwari & Brindavan Gardens
itineraries.description: Arrive in Mysore. Hotel check-in. Visit Mysore Palace, Chamundeshwari Temple atop Chamundi Hills, and illuminated Brindavan Gardens.

itineraries.title: Mysore to Ooty – Queen of Hill Stations & Tea Gardens
itineraries.description: Scenic drive ascending Nilgiri Ghats. Visit Doddabetta Peak, Botanical Garden, Pine Forest, Ooty Lake boating, and tea plantations.

itineraries.title: Ooty to Munnar via Pollachi Coconut Groves & Waterfalls
itineraries.description: Drive through scenic Pollachi coconut plantations, waterfalls, and ghats into Munnar tea paradise. Hotel check-in.

itineraries.title: Munnar Sightseeing to Thekkady Spice Trails
itineraries.description: Explore Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point, Kundala Lake, and Munnar Tea Museum. Proceed to Thekkady for spice plantation tour and shopping.

itineraries.title: Thekkady to Alleppey Backwaters Boating & Fort Kochi
itineraries.description: Alleppey backwaters boating experience. Afternoon transfer to Kochi for Fort Kochi, Chinese Fishing Nets, and Marine Drive.

itineraries.title: Kochi City Heritage & Return Journey to Pune
